title: Introducing The 250 Gift List
summary: Meet The 250 Gift List, Goldbelly’s 2026–2027 list of extraordinary food gifts from America’s most celebrated chefs, restaurants, and bakeries, from stone crab to PieCaken.
body_markdown:
Published on November 19th, 2026


## Our 2026–2027 guide to gifts for every taste


The 250 Gift List is Goldbelly’s 2026–2027 list of extraordinary food gifts, handcrafted by America’s most celebrated chefs, restaurants, and makers. It brings together more than 250 iconic dishes and desserts from over 200 legendary spots across the country: Texas brisket from Franklin Barbecue, stone crab from Miami’s Joe’s Stone Crab, Chicago deep dish from Lou Malnati’s, the PieCaken from Zac Young, and much more. Every gift ships nationwide, and there’s something for every person and every occasion, from Thanksgiving through next holiday season.


Because the best gatherings deserve unforgettable food.


[Shop The 250 Gift List](https://www.goldbelly.com/collections/250-gifts-for-every-taste)


**The 250 Gift List at a glance**


- **What it is:** Goldbelly’s definitive list of food gifts for 2026–2027
- **How many gifts:** more than 250, from over 200 restaurants, bakeries, chefs, and makers
- **Price range:** from $45 to about $450, with more than 100 gifts under $100
- **What’s on it:** barbecue, steaks, seafood, pizza, deli classics, cakes, pies, cookies, chef-made meals, and holiday treats
- **Who it’s for:** everyone on your list, from the barbecue fanatic to the dessert lover
- **When to use it:** the holidays, birthdays, thank-yous, corporate gifts, and every celebration in between


### **Gifts for the barbecue lover**


- [Franklin Barbecue’s Whole Brisket + Texas BBQ Sauce](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/franklin-barbecue/whole-brisket-texas-bbq-sauce) : a whole Black Angus brisket from the Austin smokehouse Bon Appétit once named the best barbecue in America.
- [Salt Lick BBQ’s Family Style BBQ Sampler](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/the-salt-lick/family-style-bbq-sampler) : a whole brisket, pork spare ribs, and Hill Country sausage from the Texas Hill Country institution, open since 1967.
- [Charlie Vergos’ Rendezvous Memphis Ribs](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/charlie-vergos-rendezvous/18452111-memphis-ribs-choose-your-bundle) : the famous charcoal-cooked ribs from downtown Memphis.
- [Perini Ranch Steakhouse’s Mesquite Smoked Peppered Beef Tenderloin](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/perini-ranch-steakhouse/mesquite-smoked-peppered-beef-tenderloin) : a James Beard American Classic from Buffalo Gap, Texas, fully cooked and ready to slice.


### **Gifts for the seafood lover**


- [Joe’s Stone Crab’s Joe’s Entitlement](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/joes-stone-crab/joes-entitlement) : stone crab claws with Joe’s signature mustard sauce, a Miami Beach tradition.
- [McLoons Lobster Shack’s Maine Lobster Roll Kit](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/mcloons-lobster-shack/maine-lobster-roll-kit-4-pack) : the half-butter, half-mayo roll Yankee Magazine named the best in Maine.
- [Chef Thomas Keller’s Regiis Ova Caviar Trio](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/regiis-ova-caviar-by-thomas-keller/choose-your-own-caviar-trio) : three jars of caviar from the chef behind The French Laundry.
- [Hog Island Oyster Co.’s Pro Shuckers Kit](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/hogislandoysters/pro-shuckers-kit) : everything for an oyster feast at home.


### **Gifts for the pizza and deli lover**


- [Lou Malnati’s 6 Deep Dish Pizzas](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/lou-malnatis-pizzeria/6-lou-malnatis-deep-dish-pizzas) : Chicago deep dish from the pizzeria Lou and Jean Malnati opened in 1971.
- [Pizzeria Bianco’s Wood Fired Pizzas Best Seller](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/pizzeria-bianco/wood-fired-pizzas-best-seller-4-pack) : from Phoenix’s Chris Bianco, the first pizzaiolo to win a James Beard Award.
- [Langer’s Deli’s Original #19 Sandwich](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/langers-deli/langers-original-19-sandwich) : hand-cut pastrami, coleslaw, Russian dressing, and Swiss on double-baked rye, from Los Angeles.
- [Ess-a-Bagel’s 50th Anniversary Bagel Brunch for 6](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/ess-a-bagel/50th-anniversary-bagel-brunch-for-6-anniversary-hat) : giant hand-rolled New York bagels with nova and cream cheese.


### **Gifts for the sweet tooth**


- [PieCaken Bakeshop’s Christmas PieCaken](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/the-piecaken-shop/the-goldbelly-christmas-piecaken) : Zac Young’s chocolate pecan pie, cherry swirl cheesecake, and red velvet cake in one dessert.
- [Levain Bakery’s Holiday Cookie Gift Tin](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/levain-bakery/holiday-cookie-gift-tin) : the famous six-ounce New York cookies in a limited-edition holiday tin.
- [Junior’s Red Velvet Cheesecake](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/juniors-cheesecake/red-velvet-cheesecake) : red velvet cake and New York cheesecake from the Brooklyn landmark.
- [Magnolia Bakery’s Classic Banana Pudding](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/magnolia-bakery/classic-banana-pudding-multipack) : six cups of the New York bakery’s iconic pudding.
- [Hansen’s Cakes’ Signature Basket Weave Cake](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/hansens-cakes/signature-basket-weave-cake) : a hand-piped showpiece from the Los Angeles cake shop.


### **Gifts from celebrated chefs**


- [Chef José Andrés’s Tapas the José Andrés Way](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/chef-jose-andres/tapas-the-jose-andres-way) : Spanish tapas, including chicken croquetas, from the James Beard Award–winning chef.
- [Chef Daniel Boulud’s Gourmet Holiday Collection](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/daniel-boulud-kitchen/daniel-bouluds-gourmet-holiday-collection) : canelés, madeleines, and more sweet and savory treats from the chef behind New York’s DANIEL.
- [Zahav’s Lamb Shoulder Meal Kit](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/zahav/zahav-lamb-shoulder-meal-kit) : Michael Solomonov’s famous pomegranate-glazed lamb shoulder, from Philadelphia.
- [Commander’s Palace Three-Course Shrimp & Grits Dinner for 4](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/commanders-palace/commanders-palace-3-course-shrimp-and-grits-dinner-for-4) : turtle soup or gumbo, shrimp and grits, and pecan pie from the New Orleans landmark.


### **Gifts under $60**


- [Royer’s Round Top Café’s Texas Trash Pie](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/royers-round-top-cafe/15637-royers-texas-trash-pie) : Bud “The Pieman” Royer’s candy-bar pie from Round Top, Texas.
- [Gooey Louie’s Original Gooey Butter Cake](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/gooey-louie-gooey-butter-cake/original-gooey-butter-cake) : the St. Louis classic, shipped in its own baking tin.
- [Jacques Torres’s World Famous Chocolate Chip Cookies](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/jacques-torres-chocolate/jacques-world-famous-chocolate-chip-cookies) : giant cookies that are mostly chocolate.
- [Milk Bar Pie](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/milk-bar/milk-bar-pie) : the gooey, salty-sweet pie that put Milk Bar on the map.
- [Breads Bakery’s Chocolate Babka](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/breads-bakery/24011-breads-bakery-chocolate-babka-3-pack) : the “Best of New York” babka that started the babka revival.


### **Not sure what to send?**


Let them choose. The[Commemorative Gift Card Box](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/goldbelly-gift-cards/commemorative-gift-card-box-experience) pairs a Goldbelly gift card with a box to unwrap, so they can pick their own favorite from the list.


[Shop all of The 250 Gift List](https://www.goldbelly.com/collections/250-gifts-for-every-taste)
